tagline: Open Pore Minimizer Toner – Tightens, Clarifies & Refines Skin
intro: Refresh and rebalance your skin with KB Open Pore Minimizer Toner, a powerful yet gentle formula designed to visibly reduce open pores, control excess oil, and improve overall skin texture. Infused with AHA & BHA, this toner deeply cleanses pores, helping to remove blackheads, dark spots, and pimples while preventing future breakouts.

Enhanced with Niacinamide, it soothes the skin, improves elasticity, and strengthens the skin barrier, leaving your skin smoother, tighter, and more refined. Ideal for normal to oily skin, this dermatologist-tested toner preps your skin for better absorption of skincare products.

p: • Minimizes the appearance of open pores
• Controls excess oil and balances skin
After cleansing, apply toner to a cotton pad and gently sweep over face and neck. Use once or twice daily as needed.
Perfect for clearer, smoother, and visibly refined skin with every use

full: Open Pore Minimizer Toner – Tightens, Clarifies & Refines Skin
